claims: The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament First Four is held March 17–18 at UD Arena in Dayton, Ohio.
The dates are Tuesday, March 17, 2026 and Wednesday, March 18, 2026.
UD Arena has hosted the First Four since 2011, except 2021.
The First Four features matchups between the lowest-seeded automatic qualifiers and last at-large teams.
The 2026 First Four games include UMBC vs. Howard.
The 2026 First Four games include Texas vs. NC State.
The 2026 First Four games include Prairie View A&M vs. Lehigh.
The 2026 First Four games include Miami (Ohio) vs. SMU.
All 2026 First Four games air on TruTV.
The 2026 First Four games can be streamed on March Madness Live, Sling TV, or HBO Max.
The purpose of the First Four is to determine four teams that advance to the main 64-team bracket first round.
The First Four allows the NCAA to expand the tournament to 68 teams.
